tasks.title: Group A: Moon image diameter
tasks.statement: The apparent diameter of the Moon, as seen from the Earth, is 31'. What is the image diameter in the objective focal plane if its focal length is 254 cm and the objective diameter is 40 cm? Draw a figure (a few figures) to explain your calculations.

parts.question: What is the image diameter in the objective focal plane if its focal length is 254 cm and the objective diameter is 40 cm? Draw a figure (a few figures) to explain your calculations.

tasks.title: Group A: Photometer observations
tasks.statement: A photometer is mounted on a 125 cm (focal length) telescope. Can you observe a star with magnitude in a cluster if a count from a star of a similar spectral type with magnitude 8 gives 4000 counts/second? The level of white noise of the photometer (instrumental noise) is 500 counts/second; the upper limiting value for observations is 200000 counts/second. Explain your calculations.

tasks.title: Group B: Radiation of two stars
tasks.statement: One star peaks at 2000 A. Another peaks at 10000 A. Which one emits more radiation at 2000 A? Which one emits more radiation at 10000 A? What is the ratio of the total radiation emitted by the two stars? Consider the stars as black bodies.

parts.question: Which one emits more radiation at 2000 A? Which one emits more radiation at 10000 A? What is the ratio of the total radiation emitted by the two stars?

tasks.title: Group B: Black hole from a military ship
tasks.statement: Engineers from the Simferopol University describe a new method to utilize old military ships: to construct very small black holes from their material (patent yzarc-048UA7). Estimate the diameter of a black hole constructed using this patent from a ship with the mass of 5000 tn (1 tn = 1000 kg). What physical object has a size of the same order of magnitude? Describe propagation of visible light near this black hole.

parts.question: Estimate the diameter of a black hole constructed using this patent from a ship with the mass of 5000 tn. What physical object has a size of the same order of magnitude? Describe propagation of visible light near this black hole.

tasks.title: Sunrise with the longest duration
tasks.statement: Where (on the Earth) and when is it possible to observe the sunrise with the longest duration? Estimate its duration.

parts.question: Where (on the Earth) and when is it possible to observe the sunrise with the longest duration? Estimate its duration.

tasks.title: Circumpolar stars estimation
tasks.statement: Usually we consider that there are about 6000 stars in the whole sky which are visible by our eyes. Estimate, how many visible stars are circumpolar (which means that they never set):

parts.question: a. if you are placed 1 from the North Pole.
b. if you are placed 1 from the Equator (to the North).

tasks.title: Airship motion to observe sunset
tasks.statement: An airship started from a cosmodrome located near the equator of the earth at the moment of a sunset. A pilot of the airship wants to continue to observe the sun on the horizon. What should the speed of moving of the airship be? Describe in detail the motion of the air ship.

parts.question: What should the speed of moving of the airship be? Describe in detail the motion of the air ship.

tasks.title: Solar eclipse shadow speed
tasks.statement: Suppose that a total solar eclipse is observed from a place at the equator when the sun is in zenith. Also, suppose that the shadow of the moon moves along the equator. Calculate the speed of the shadow relative to the observer.

parts.question: Calculate the speed of the shadow relative to the observer.
